calculation_handling.description: In the RM zone, the rear main wall of a detached or semi-detached house may be no more than 19.0 m from the required minimum front yard setback (maximum building depth), not counting a one-storey extension that complies with 10.80.40.20(2).
calculation_handling.gaps: The one-storey rear extension allowance (10.80.40.20(2)) is keyed in that regulation, not here.

10.80.40.30(1).explanation: In the RM zone, the back wall of a detached or semi-detached house can be at most 19.0 m behind the required front yard setback, not counting a permitted one-storey rear extension.
